title: Airline Operations: Departures at Risk

transcript.speaker: Linda Chen
transcript.text: This is Linda Chen, SkyWest Operations, calling from Gate A4. We’ve just heard through internal comms that there’s a security situation unfolding. Is it confirmed? We have eight departures scheduled between 11:00 and noon — five to Chicago, two to Dallas, one to Denver. We’re holding boarding for 11:15, but if this is real, we need to know now.

transcript.speaker: Marcus R. Jones
transcript.text: Ms. Chen, we’re aware of a potential threat vector, but no confirmed breach. We’re evaluating. I advise you to hold all boarding until further notice. Do not allow passengers to proceed to the gate unless cleared by AOC.

transcript.speaker: Linda Chen
transcript.text: Understood. We’ll hold all boarding. But if this is a false alarm, we risk massive delays. We need a status update by 10:30. The next flight to Chicago is at 11:10.

voiceStyles.Linda Chen: Woman in her 30s, calm but urgent, slight background airport PA noise
voiceStyles.Marcus R. Jones: Man in his 40s, steady, controlled, with a slight pause after 'evaluating'

instructorNote: This inject introduces external pressure on Ops to make a decision under uncertainty. Watch for whether Ops communicates a firm hold on boarding, or delays action and risks cascading delays.
